question:
Which of the following numbers will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

?, 11, 35, 107, 323
solution:
The logic followed here is:

**First multiplied by (3), then added (2) subsequently.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b71d918b664224ab433186d0662b7e435cfcd24b0dc61c7e71ccee57dc48b67.png] 

Hence, **"3"** is the correct answer.
